bib.title: OLMo: Accelerating the Science of Language Models

question: Can a competitive language model be released together with its training data, code, checkpoints and logs so the research community can study LMs scientifically?
hypothesis: Full openness (data, code, checkpoints, logs) is essential for scientific study of LMs and can be achieved without a large capability gap to Llama 2.
contributions: OLMo 1B and 7B models (four 7B variants) trained to at least 2T tokens, Apache 2.0
Open pretraining data Dolma and tools for reproducing data order
Training and evaluation code, 500+ intermediate checkpoints, W&B logs
Adapted models OLMo+SFT and OLMo+SFT+DPO with code and data

method.summary: Decoder-only transformers (1B, 7B) pretrained on a 2T-token sample of Dolma with AdamW, FSDP/ZeRO, bf16 mixed precision, on LUMI (AMD) and MosaicML (NVIDIA) clusters. Evaluated zero-shot on 8 core tasks and Paloma perplexity, then adapted with Tulu-style SFT and DPO.
method.task: next-token pretraining; instruction tuning and DPO

datasets.name: Dolma
datasets.size: 2,668B tokens, 4,367M docs, 11,519 GB total; 2T-token sample used
datasets.split: single epoch to 2T; some models continue into a second epoch with different shuffle
datasets.source: Common Crawl 2,180B tok, GitHub 342B, Reddit 80B, Semantic Scholar 57B, Gutenberg 5.2B, Wikipedia 3.7B
datasets.preprocessing: language, quality, content filtering, dedup, mixing, tokenization; EOS appended per document, concatenated, chunked to 2048 tokens; Paloma-leaking documents removed

datasets.name: Tulu V2 SFT mix (OLMo resplit)
datasets.preprocessing: hardcoded split replaced with data about OLMo

datasets.name: UltraFeedback (Argilla cleaned binarized)
datasets.preprocessing: TruthfulQA prompts removed; average of GPT aspect scores picks chosen/rejected

datasets.name: 8 core tasks (arc_easy, arc_challenge, boolq, openbookqa, sciq, hellaswag, piqa, winogrande)

models.name: OLMo-1B
models.architecture: decoder-only transformer, no biases, non-parametric LN, SwiGLU, RoPE, weight tying
models.tokenizer: modified GPT-NeoX-20B BPE with PII mask tokens

models.name: OLMo-7B
models.architecture: as 1B, no weight tying, MLP hidden 11,008 (22,016 into SwiGLU)

models.name: Falcon-7B, LLaMA 7B, Llama 2 7B, MPT-7B, Pythia 6.9B, RPJ-INCITE-7B, StableLM 1.6B, Pythia 1B, TinyLlama 1.1B

training.objective: next-token prediction (inferred: causal LM); SFT; DPO
training.lr_schedule: linear decay to a tenth of peak (min 3.0E-05 for 7B); final 1000 steps decayed linearly to 0 for the evaluated 7B checkpoint
training.warmup: 5000 steps (~21B tokens) per Sec 3.2 for all sizes; Table 1 says 2000 steps for 1B
training.batch_size: ~4M tokens (2048 instances x 2048 tokens); Table 5 lists 2160 instances for OLMo-7B
training.epochs: 1 over 2T tokens; some models continue into a second epoch
training.precision: bf16 mixed precision via FSDP/amp; softmax in full precision; master weights, optimizer state and gradient reduce in FP32
training.regularisation: gradient clipping global l2 norm 1.0 after warmup
training.hardware: LUMI up to 256 nodes x 4 AMD MI250X (128GB); MosaicML 27 nodes x 8 NVIDIA A100 40GB; 800Gbps interconnect
training.compute: energy 239 MWh for 7B models (135 MWh MI250X, 104 MWh A100)

other.distributed: ZeRO via PyTorch FSDP, micro-batch 4096 tokens per GPU at 7B
other.SFT: LR 2e-6, 3 epochs, linear warmup 3% then linear cooldown to 0, WD 0, no grad clipping, max seq 2048
other.DPO: LR 5e-7, beta 0.1, 3 epochs, warmup 10% then linear to 0, WD 0, no grad clipping, max seq 2048
other.released_variants: 7B, 7B-twin-2T, 1B, plus two other 7B variants with different arch/optimizer/hardware (not detailed)

inference.prompting: zero-shot rank classification for core tasks; TruthfulQA default QA prompt with 6 in-context examples; MMLU 0-shot; chat template where available

parameters.likelihood_normalization: unconditional for arc and openbookqa; per-token for hellaswag, piqa, winogrande; none for boolq and sciq

other.toxigen: 500 hateful prompts per group, roberta-large classifier

metrics.name: zero-shot accuracy (8 core tasks)
metrics.definition: rank classification of candidate completions by (normalized) likelihood

metrics.name: bits per byte
metrics.definition: Paloma, per Gao et al. 2020, over 11 sources

metrics.name: TruthfulQA %Info+True
metrics.definition: informative and truthful by LLaMA 2 judges

eval.protocol: single run per model; no significance tests; Tulu 2 TruthfulQA not reported for contamination

availability.weights: released with 500+ intermediate checkpoints at 1000-step intervals

results.claim: OLMo-7B (2.46T-token checkpoint) averages 69.3 on 8 zero-shot core tasks, near Llama 2 7B (70.5) and MPT-7B (69.8), above Pythia 6.9B (63.0).
results.setup: Zero-shot rank classification, Catwalk, OLMo-7B 2.46T checkpoint

results.claim: OLMo-1B averages 60.4 on the same 8 tasks, vs TinyLlama 1.1B 59.4 and Pythia 1B 54.5.

results.setup: Both 7B runs combined, power measured per node every 25ms, PUE 1.1

results.note: No ablation number given in text; Fig 1 shows the late jump.

OLMo-7B has 88.8% Common Crawl in pretraining data and overtakes all models on C4 bits per byte.

results.claim: OLMo+SFT+DPO scores 46.2 MMLU 0-shot, 69.3 AlpacaEval win%, 1.7% toxic, 52.0 %Info+True.

results.claim: Base OLMo-7B is 81.4% toxic on ToxiGen; SFT lowers it to 14.4 and DPO to 1.7.
results.setup: 500 hateful prompts per group, greedy, up to 512 tokens, roberta-large classifier

limits: English-only pretraining data; may contain toxic, personal and copyrighted text
No training logs of diverged or failed runs given
Adaptation reuses a Tulu mix designed for Llama; gap to Tulu 2 remains
Downstream tasks do not represent chatbot use; evaluations noisy
Carbon figures are lower bounds (exclude debugging, tuning, embodied emissions)
Authors say later releases improved results substantially
Perplexity on code may be underestimated by contamination
